title: Lightly Smoked Polish Rye Pilaf
description: A winey, fluffy, and show-off Polish dish featuring rye, this pilaf is perfect for special occasions, and is egg-free-friendly for all to enjoy. It combines the deep flavors of smoked ingredients with the earthy taste of rye.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the rye grains and stir to coat them evenly with the oil and mix with the onion and garlic.
Add the smoked paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the white wine and cook until it is almost completely absorbed, stirring frequently.
Add the vegetable broth, one cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to be absorbed before adding the next.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rye is tender and fluffy.
Remove from heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
